content:
Gordon Ramsay has a lot to be thankful for on Thanksgiving day.

The British celebrity chef, 60, is officially a grandpa after his daughter Holly Ramsay-Peaty welcomed her first child with her husband, Adam Peaty.

“Daphne June Ramsay-Peaty, Welcome to the World [heart emoji],” she began in the caption, revealing her baby girl’s name. “You’ll forever be our beautiful baby girl and George’s baby sister.”

“Thank you to all the Doctors, Nurses and Midwives who made sure we were safe, healthy and happy - we will forever be grateful,” Ramsay-Peaty continued in the post, alongside photos of her and her husband cradling their newborn in the hospital.

Ramsay-Peaty shared in the caption that their bundle of joy was born on Nov. 25.

Her dad beamed in the comments section, writing, “Welcome Miss Daphne, congratulations to Adam & Holly wow wow wow.”

The couple, who wed in December 2025, first revealed they were expanding their family in a June Instagram post, writing, “Baby Ramsay-Peaty coming December 2026.”

“We can’t wait to meet our baby girl,” they added alongside a photo of them posing with her growing baby bump.

Ramsay-Peaty is Gordon Ramsay’s second eldest child. The “Hell’s Kitchen” star has six children with his wife, Tana Ramsay.

Gordon Ramsay gushed about becoming a granddad in a Nov. 18 appearance on “Jimmy Kimmel Live!,” hours after his Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony.

“To be a granddad, you know, in your 60s, I think is amazing,” the chef said. “We are so excited.”

“It’s nice that we’ve still got young boys as well, at the same time,” he told host Jimmy Kimmel. Ramsey’s youngest children are his sons Oscar, 7, and Jesse, 3. “So, yeah, I’m looking forward to it,” Ramsey added.

At his Hollywood Walk of Fame ceremony, Ramsey revealed what he’ll have his first grandchild call him.

“I think I’m going to be called Papa G. Papa G. with a star in Hollywood!” he told People and other publications after the ceremony.
